notes.title: New Game: "Not Easy" Demo Out Now
notes.content:
Not Easy is a hardcore platformer game that will put your skills and patience to the test. Play the demo now and try out the first 10 levels. Like it? Wishlist it on Steam, and you will be notified when the full game comes out. 

Prepare yourself for the ultimate challenge with Not Easy, a hardcore platformer designed to push you to your absolute limits. Navigate through relentless obstacles and gather keys to unlock doors, advancing to the next level. With around 60 intense levels, this game will test your skills, patience, and perseverance. Are you ready to prove your mastery?

Features:

 60 Intense Levels: Each level designed to challenge your platforming skills.
 Relentless Obstacles: Face a variety of obstacles that will push you to your limits.
 Key Collecting Mechanics: Gather keys to unlock doors and progress to the next level.
 Hardcore Gameplay: Perfect for players who crave a demanding and rewarding experience.


Check out Not Easy on Steam

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 New Stage and Feature
notes.content:
Hello gamers,

It's been a while but we are back with a new stage as promised. This update adds a fifth stage in the game. This stage is a bit different from the previous ones. Most of the graphics you see here, even the tile-sets are digitally drawn. Just thought it would be a fun idea to implement. Besides that, it also brings a stage selector option. So, now you can choose a specific stage to play from the main menu. Stuck at some point of a stage? No problemo! You can use the stage selector to try a different stage. However, in order to get all the achievements, you have to play and complete every stage. Oh, and yes, there's a new achievement, too. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42809196/693f703698e0b064deeff3b8f88fd191472d2b0b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42809196/ee63e52dc1dc50b2fb7538d24dacdad0bc5ac038.jpg

Happy gaming!
Red Bean Games

notes.title: Visual Overhaul & First Sale!
notes.content:
We have received multiple feedbacks on social media, and our store page about the game not being visually appealing. We hear you. And so today, we dropped a visual overhaul update for Stage 1, and a minor update for Stage 2. What changed? 

 The old tile-set for Stage 1 has been completely replaced by a new one
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42809196/efca311de7ec11b86d127bebe4fe1e8c72bef878.png
 Added parallax cloud background for both stage 1 and stage 2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42809196/e40bd0b16e4b1189ef5a2d83a17942ad9f24e7a9.png


We would also like to announce a new stage that will be added to the game shorty. If you look at the following picture, you will notice that for this new stage, we are actually using digitally drawn tile-set to give it a different look than our previous stages. Please keep in mind that it is still being worked on and the final version may look slightly different. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42809196/2fdccfe059432d20e85f1cc2e147637c213b2f14.png

Also, Kitty's Venture is ON SALE for the first time! Grab it now with a 10% discount. 

With that being said, we wish you all a Happy Thanksgiving! We will be back soon with more updates. :)

Red Bean Games

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
Hello gamers! Here's a little update on the development progress of Kitty's Venture. 

We mentioned on our Steam page that the game will have three different stages. The designing of the first two stages is complete. Now, we are working on the third stage. There's still a lot of other things that we need to work on such as UI designing, audio, achievements designing and integration, controls, etc. After all that, we plan to do an extensive testing to make sure that there's no bug, and the game is not bizarrely difficult. The good news is that we have made really good progress with the development, and it happened faster than we first expected. If everything proceeds according to plan, we will be able to release the game in September. However, if for some reason that is not possible, we will consider releasing it in October. But for now, September is looking good! 

In the meantime, don't forget to Wishlist the game, and share it with friends! 
Thank you!
Red Bean Games
